summary: Tested 3 new admin email endpoints and their corresponding UI elements for 4Luis crowdfunding platform. All backend tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI tests confirmed all email buttons and features are working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/weekly-summary requires admin auth (401 without)
Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/weekly-summary sends emails and returns {sent, journeys_count}
Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/dream-funded/{id} requires admin auth (401 without)
Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/dream-funded/{id} returns 404 for non-existent journey
Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/dream-funded/{id} sends emails and marks journey as 'financiada'
Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/dream-funded/{id} sets funded_email_sent=true and funded_at timestamp
Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/new-journey/{id} requires admin auth (401 without)
Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/new-journey/{id} returns 404 for non-existent journey
Backend: POST /api/admin/emails/new-journey/{id} sends emails and sets announcement_email_sent=true
Backend: Existing journeys (China, Japao) accessible via API
Backend: SENDER_EMAIL configured as mail@4luis.com (emails sent successfully)
Frontend: Admin page loads with 9 journeys displayed
Frontend: 'Resumo Semanal' button visible in journey list header with data-testid='send-weekly-summary-btn'
Frontend: Journey edit form opens when clicking pencil icon
Frontend: Edit form contains 'Configurações' section with 'Emails' subsection
Frontend: 'Anunciar Novo Sonho' button visible with data-testid='send-new-journey-email-{id}'
Frontend: 'Anunciar Sonho Financiado' button correctly hidden for journeys < 100% funded
Frontend: Edit form shows journey details (China - 2.5% funded, 50000€ goal, 1250€ raised)
critical_code_review_comments: Backend email helper functions (_build_standard_email, _build_email_progress_bar, _build_email_cta_button) are well-structured and reusable
All 3 email endpoints properly validate admin authentication before sending
Dream funded endpoint correctly updates journey status to 'financiada' and sets funded_at timestamp
New journey endpoint correctly sets announcement_email_sent=true to prevent duplicate sends
Frontend correctly shows 'Anunciar Sonho Financiado' only when percentage >= 100%
SENDER_EMAIL environment variable correctly configured as mail@4luis.com
seed_data_creation: Test journeys created and deleted during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin email system fully tested. Three new email endpoints working: (1) /admin/emails/weekly-summary sends weekly summary to all users, (2) /admin/emails/dream-funded/{id} sends funded announcement and marks journey as 'financiada', (3) /admin/emails/new-journey/{id} sends new journey announcement and sets announcement_email_sent=true. UI buttons in Admin.js: 'Resumo Semanal' in header, 'Anunciar Novo Sonho' and 'Anunciar Sonho Financiado' in journey edit form under Configurações > Emails. The funded button only shows for journeys >= 100% funded.

new_journey_email.ui_button: 'Anunciar Novo Sonho' (hidden after sent, shows 'Anuncio enviado' badge)
